verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes Docusign functioning as an MCP *server* that other AI clients (Claude, Gemini CLI, Copilot) connect to and use — not Docusign itself consuming or plugging in external MCP servers to use their tools. There is no evidence of Docusign acting as an MCP client that ingests third-party MCP tool servers, which is what this story requires.
